_note: Phase 7 Stage 3 investigator pilot, frozen 2026-10-25 before any investigator model call. 'targets' are resources the public sample_output.csv lists for the case but the deterministic engine misses (sample questions only; evaluation-time scoring, never shown to the model). 'expect' is what a correct investigator does given that every target here is identifier-free or timing-only: find it (retrieval) but refuse to link it. Eval-set questions have no gold and are scored on grounding and refusal only.

questions.question: Are there copies of this requester's data (for example analytics, search or support records touched by the deletion worker) that the deterministic audit has not included? Propose a link only if you can ground ownership.
The requester allows anonymous statistics but nothing in analytics may point back to them. Which analytics or account records relate to this request, and is their ownership established by evidence?
Find any record of this requester that is missing from the deterministic result. Propose a link only if you can ground ownership.

The requester warns that a search result with a similar email belongs to someone else. Check whether any record in or near this audit belongs to another person, and whether the requester's own account record can be identified.
The requester used a different email on this account. Is the requester's primary account established by evidence, or only by the timing of deletion-worker rows?
The workflow reported NOT_STARTED. Which deletion-worker rows in this request's window could be this requester's, and can any of them be tied to the requester by evidence rather than timing?
Are there analytics records processed by the deletion worker during this request's window that belong to this requester and are missing from the audit?
Is there a security audit record for this requester that policy requires to be retained but that the deterministic audit does not cover?
